svg.desc: Generated with MathJax 3.2.0 from this TeX (title, then body): \textbf{Listing 2}\quad \mathrm{D}{\small\mathrm{ECIDE}}(\mathcal{L}, q)\text{: the two prices of MM}\_\text{algo2} \begin{array}{rll} {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 1} & \textbf{if }\text{the top is missing or crossed, or a side has fewer than }k\text{ levels} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.1} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 2} & \hspace{1.4em}\textbf{return }\text{no quote} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 3} & V^b \gets \textstyle\sum_{i < k} \rho^{\,i}\, v^b_i,\quad V^a \gets \textstyle\sum_{i < k} \rho^{\,i}\, v^a_i & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.2} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 4} & \textbf{if }V^b + V^a < n_V S\textbf{ then }I \gets 0,\ \ p \gets m\quad\text{(thin book)} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.3} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 5} & \textbf{else }I \gets \mathrm{clip}\bigl((V^b - V^a)/(V^b + V^a),\ {-0.8},\ 0.8\bigr) & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.4} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 6} & \hspace{1.4em}p \gets (a_0 v^b_0 + b_0 v^a_0)/(v^b_0 + v^a_0)\quad\text{(microprice)} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.5} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 7} & x \gets \mathrm{clip}\bigl((q - q_{\min})/(q_{\max} - q_{\min}),\ 0,\ 1\bigr) & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.6} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 8} & c \gets p\,(1 + \beta I)\,\bigl(1 - \sigma_q(2x - 1)\bigr) & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.7} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 9} & G \gets (1 + r_{\min})/(1 - f)^2 - 1,\quad h \gets \max\bigl(h_0,\ G/(2 + G) + \epsilon/c\bigr) & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.8} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 10} & B \gets \lfloor \min(c(1 - h),\ a_0 - \epsilon) \rfloor_\epsilon,\quad A \gets \lceil \max(c(1 + h),\ b_0 + \epsilon) \rceil_\epsilon & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.9} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 11} & \textbf{if }B \ge A\textbf{ or }(1 - f)^2 A/B - 1 \le r_{\min}\textbf{ then return }\text{no quote} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.10} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 12} & \textbf{if }\text{the last pair }(B_0, A_0)\text{ is younger than }T_r\text{, still clears the bar,} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.12} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 13} & \hspace{1.4em}\textbf{and }\lvert B - B_0\rvert \le w(B_0),\ \lvert A - A_0\rvert \le w(A_0)\textbf{ then }(B, A) \gets (B_0, A_0) & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 14} & \textbf{return }(B, A) & \end{array}
